name: My Darling
source:
My Darling is a free visual novel where you spend time with Takuya, your perfect boyfriend. You're back home and Takuya is happy to see you. Be ready to have a nice evening.

[From [url=https://water-horse-games.itch.io/my-darling]itch.io[/url]]
